name: shams-al-asrar-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions — Shams al-Asrar RKP engine (server-side)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
scripts.test:emulator:suites: REQUIRE_EMULATOR=1 RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=100000 vitest run --no-file-parallelism --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=emulator-results.json account.emulator stripLegacyLogFields && node scripts/check-emulator-results.mjs emulator-results.json
scripts.test:emulator:ci: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-shams --only firestore,auth "npm run test:emulator:suites"
